net.Send [m: msg] from [a: node] to [b: node]
    action; node; Send through the network from `a`, which must be the receiver
net.Latency between [a: time] and [b: time]
    action; main; Uniform delay per message (default 10ms–30ms)
net.Loss [p: number]
    action; main; Probability each message is lost (default 0)
net.Partition [a: list of node] from [b: list of node]
    action; main; Cut every link between the two groups
net.Heal
    action; main; Remove all partitions
net.DropNext [type: text] from [a: node] to [b: node]
    action; main; Drop the next message of that record type (unqualified name) on that link
net.Received [m: msg] from [a: node]
    node event; node; Node event: a message arrives at the receiving node
net.Sent [m: msg] from [a: node] to [b: node]
    trace event; look; Trace event: net.Send m from a to b
net.Arrived [m: msg] from [a: node] to [b: node]
    trace event; look; Trace event: the message is received
net.Dropped [m: msg] from [a: node] to [b: node] because [r: text]
    trace event; look; Trace event: loss, partition, crash or net.DropNext
net.Partitioned [a: list of node] from [b: list of node]
    trace event; look; Trace event: net.Partition
net.Healed
    trace event; look; Trace event: net.Heal
net.Id [m: msg]
    gives number; look; The message id of the net fact that bound `m`
net.Type [m: msg]
    gives text; look; The unqualified record type name of `m`
